export_profiles.label: c2_standard
export_profiles.notes: Use for operational exports that MUST NOT include c3/c4. Suitable for most order/seat/pricing exports when identifiers are non-joinable or aggregated.

export_profiles.label: c3_attendee_pii
export_profiles.notes: Use only when business need requires attendee PII. Must apply PII-1 joinable identifier ceiling rules and log audit reason codes.

export_profiles.label: c4_regulated
export_profiles.notes: Reserved for regulated/high-risk exports. Must require super_admin workflow and governance break-glass (GOV-0 waiver_id).

export_profiles.label: break_glass_pii
export_profiles.notes: Emergency export path (investigation/incident). Requires break-glass approvals per IAM-2/DSAR-1 and must be time-boxed + audited.

labeling.rule: Every Ash Resource attribute MUST declare both metadata.data_class (c0–c4) and metadata.retention_profile (p0–p4). Missing labels are forbidden.

label_field.purpose: Associate a classification class and retention profile with a field/attribute.
validation_rules: class_id MUST be one of c0,c1,c2,c3,c4

purge_expired.purpose: Apply retention rules to purge/tombstone expired records and artifacts within org_id scope.
validation_rules: System purges MUST run with actor.type == :system

hashing.rule: When logging identifiers, use keyed hashes to prevent reversal.

logging_policy: Logs MUST NOT include c3/c4 values.
Allowed exception: stable hashes or last4 where explicitly approved.

rules: Tenant isolation MUST be enforced for all c1+ data at rest and in transit.
Exports containing c3/c4 MUST be capability-gated and audited; org_id MUST be enforced for all export selection and delivery.
Ledger/journal entries and payout evidence MUST NOT be hard-purged; only additive corrections are permitted.
Retention taxonomy MUST be single-source-of-truth: use DATA-1 classification.classes (c0–c4) and retention.profiles (p0–p4). Domain contracts MUST NOT define parallel taxonomies.
ARCH-1 RetentionPolicy MUST use DATA-1 ids directly: RetentionPolicy.data_class MUST be one of c0–c4, and RetentionPolicy.retention_profile MUST be one of p0_public..p4_finance_records.

negative.description: Attempting to write c3/c4 data to a Redis-backed cache MUST be rejected.
Retention jobs MUST NOT purge records flagged with 'legal_hold: true'.
Data export requests missing 'projection_allowlist' MUST return ERR_BAD_REQUEST.

If actor is revoked or loses 'pii.export' capability after request but before job execution, worker MUST abort, delete partial artifacts, emit ticketing.data.export.aborted_revoked, and MUST NOT issue any download link.

expires_at_utc.notes: Unknown/no expiry is forbidden unless the retention profile explicitly sets expires_at_required=false.

legal_hold.notes: When true, deletion/tombstone/hard_purge MUST be skipped.

profiles.description: Short-lived operational data retained for no more than 90 days, unless legal hold applies.
Finance evidence (ledger/journal entries, payout proofs). MUST NOT be hard-purged. Tombstone, if used, means suppress from operational APIs while retaining immutable audit evidence.

rules.rationale: Prevents drift and makes CI enforcement deterministic.
rules.text: DATA-1 bundle MUST be JSON-only normative artifacts with deterministic manifest hashing; repacks are forbidden.

rules.rationale: Prevents cross-tenant leakage and ambiguous behavior.
rules.text: org_id MUST be explicit and required for all tenant-scoped behaviors; missing org_id MUST fail closed.

rules.rationale: Without labeling, minimization and retention cannot be enforced.
rules.text: Every Ash Resource attribute/field MUST be labeled via metadata.data_class (c0–c4) and metadata.retention_profile (p0–p4). ci_ash_governance_lint MUST fail if any attribute is missing either metadata key.

rules.rationale: Logs are long-lived and widely accessible; avoid irreversible exposure.
rules.text: Logs/telemetry MUST NOT contain c3/c4 values; only hashed identifiers (or explicitly approved limited forms) are allowed.

rules.rationale: Prevents excessive data exposure and broken object property level authorization.
rules.text: API responses MUST use explicit projection allowlists. Default 'select all' is forbidden. All read/list actions MUST either define an action-level select list or require an input projection_allowlist (array of field names) applied to the Ash select.

rules.rationale: Defense-in-depth against leakage and privilege mistakes.
rules.text: c3/c4 fields MUST NOT be returned by default; they require explicit allowlist + authorization + org_id tenant scope.

rules.rationale: Cache leaks are common and hard to audit; class rules forbid it.
rules.text: redis/shared caches MUST NOT store c3/c4 data. Any exception MUST reference a governance waiver_id (GOV-0) and MUST specify ttl_max_seconds within the contract cap.

rules.rationale: Prevents privilege drift between request time and execution time (GC-032).
rules.text: Async export workers MUST perform a live IAM authorization + liveness check at execution time (job_perform_start) and again before issuing any download link (download_link_issue). Workers MUST NOT trust queued auth context or snapshots.

rules.rationale: Meets compliance needs and avoids accidental data loss.
rules.text: Retention profiles MUST be enforced by scheduled jobs. Entities subject to retention MUST define expires_at_utc: utc_datetime_usec when the retention profile requires expiry. legal_hold (with legal_hold_set_at_utc) MUST override tombstone/hard_purge for both records and artifacts.

rules.rationale: Financial evidence is audit-grade and constitutionally immutable; deletion is forbidden.
rules.text: Finance evidence (p4_finance_records) MUST NOT be hard-purged. Tombstone MAY only suppress access; evidence retention MUST be at least 84 months unless jurisdiction requires longer.

rules.rationale: Prevents retention drift and conflicting interpretations across services.
rules.text: Contracts that model retention MUST use DATA-1 taxonomy ids. Any contract-defined alternative taxonomy is forbidden.

rules.rationale: Closes ARCH↔DATA taxonomy drift by eliminating ambiguous mapping.
rules.text: ARCH-1 RetentionPolicy MUST include both data_class (c0–c4) and retention_profile (p0_public..p4_finance_records) and treat them as DATA-1 ids.

rules.rationale: Ensures revoked actors cannot receive or leave behind export artifacts.
rules.text: If the live authorization check denies OR liveness fails, the export job MUST abort fail-closed, MUST destroy any partial artifacts, and MUST emit audit event ticketing.data.export.aborted_revoked.

rules.rationale: Aligns export permissions to the canonical IAM capability model and prevents accidental permissive exports.
rules.text: Any export that can include data_class c3/c4 MUST require IAM capability 'pii.export' (as defined in IAM-1).

summary: Deterministic, enforceable rules for data classification (c0–c4), minimization, storage tier constraints, and retention profiles (p0–p4) for the Ticketing platform with explicit org_id multitenancy and utc_datetime_usec time discipline.
title: Data Classification & Retention Contract (Ash 3.x)
